name: Erythritol
what_is: A four-carbon polyol, or sugar alcohol, produced by fermenting a carbohydrate source with food-grade osmophilic yeasts, then purified and dried.
why_botia: BOTIA flags E968 because it is a bulk polyol, not just an intense sweetener. EFSA's 2023 re-evaluation set an ADI from human diarrhoea data. EU rules require a laxative-effect warning above 10% added polyols; WHO's 2023 recommendation excludes polyols.
can_1: Detect E968 or Erythritol and trigger the sweetener layer.
can_2: Notify the user of its low-glycemic, low-calorie properties.
cannot_1: Verify which yeast strain was used for fermentation.
cannot_2: Measure the exact quantity added to the product.
title: Erythritol
description: A non-hygroscopic polyol sugar alcohol obtained by fermenting carbohydrates with osmophilic yeasts.
